# Datavault AI to acquire CyberCatch for $94.5 million in cash
PHILADELPHIA - Datavault AI Inc. ( NASDAQ:DVLT ) announced today it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of CyberCatch Holdings , Inc. ( TSXV:CYBE ) (OTCQB:CYBHF) for $94.5 million in cash, according to a press release statement.

...

Upon closing, CyberCatch is expected to operate as a subsidiary of Datavault AI from San Diego, California. CyberCatch founder and CEO Sai Huda will serve as President of the subsidiary, reporting to Nathaniel T. Bradley, CEO of Datavault AI.
The transaction is subject to CyberCatch shareholder approval, court approval of the plan of arrangement in British Columbia, TSX Venture Exchange approvals, and other customary closing conditions.
Datavault AI provides data monetization, credentialing, digital engagement, and real-world asset tokenization technologies. The company’s platform serves multiple industries including sports, entertainment, biotech, education, fintech, real estate, healthcare, and energy.
